verdict.rationale: The only evidence of deletion is an audit-log entry, 'Admin deleted candidate', which implies admins can delete candidate records. Nothing documents user-configurable retention: the 30-day webhook log window is a fixed system behavior, not a control. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, documented deletion workflows (UI or API delete endpoint), GDPR/automatic purge controls, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: We maintain audit logs to be able to track changes to the data
